about_the_game:
This game supports Mods

(Requires accessing a third-party website via a one-click link for download)

The story begins with a dark invasion

The goddess world with seven major planets is completely shrouded in darkness

The goddesses are no match for the demons

The homes of goddesses have become playgrounds for demons

As the alien Valkyrie Akashi and her friends perceive these anomalies

They piloted the spaceship and broke through numerous obstacles to reach the world of the goddesses

They are going to search for survivors who have not been contaminated by darkness, and gather the power of the goddesses to launch a new resistance against the dark forces!

Now, a dazzling target - the Star Goddess - is fighting alone against darkness

We should go now! Go find her!

In the game, you need to plan and use coins reasonably to enhance your combat effectiveness

Attack and Defense:

Including maximum and minimum values, your ability will fluctuate between the maximum and minimum values

Magic Value:

Affects the activation of the goddess's scroll ability!

Critical Strike, Critical Strike Damage:

Some weapons or props may have these effects

They will double your damage to enemies!

There are random and hidden items in the game, try opening treasure chests more often!

Equipment and weapons are easier to enhance combat effectiveness than props, so work hard to find them!

You can also move the collected items to the shortcut bar to use!

short_description: A short ARPG game of the Tower of Demons genre, You are playing the savior of the goddess world - the Valkyrie Akashii, You need to plan and manage the collected resources, strategically engage in battles, and use various keys, In addition, there are 7 imprisoned goddesses waiting for your rescue
supported_languages: English, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
